ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْمُدَّثِّرُ ۝١
ayahs.translation: O you who covers himself [with a garment],[1788]
ayahs.translationClear: O you Enrobed one.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قُمْ فَأَنذِرْ ۝٢
ayahs.translation: Arise and warn
ayahs.translationClear: Arise and warn.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَرَبَّكَ فَكَبِّرْ ۝٣
ayahs.translation: And your Lord glorify
ayahs.translationClear: And magnify your Lord.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَثِيَابَكَ فَطَهِّرْ ۝٤
ayahs.translation: And your clothing purify
ayahs.translationClear: And purify your clothes.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱلرُّجْزَ فَٱهْجُرْ ۝٥
ayahs.translation: And uncleanliness[1789] avoid

footnotes.1789: Specifically, idols or generally, bad conduct and morals.

ayahs.translationClear: And abandon abominations.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَا تَمْنُن تَسْتَكْثِرُ ۝٦
ayahs.translation: And do not confer favor to acquire more[1790]

footnotes.1790: An alternative meaning is "Do not consider any favor you have conferred to be great."

ayahs.translationClear: And show no favor seeking gain.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلِرَبِّكَ فَٱصْبِرْ ۝٧
ayahs.translation: But for your Lord be patient.
ayahs.translationClear: And be constant for your Lord.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَإِذَا نُقِرَ فِى ٱلنَّاقُورِ ۝٨
ayahs.translation: And when the trumpet is blown,
ayahs.translationClear: When the Trumpet is blown.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَذَٰلِكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَوْمٌ عَسِيرٌ ۝٩
ayahs.translation: That Day will be a difficult day
ayahs.translationClear: That Day will be a difficult day.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: عَلَى ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ غَيْرُ يَسِيرٍ ۝١٠
ayahs.translation: For the disbelievers - not easy.
ayahs.translationClear: For the disbelievers—not easy.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ذَرْنِى وَمَنْ خَلَقْتُ وَحِيدًا ۝١١
ayahs.translation: Leave Me with the one I created alone[1791]

footnotes.1791: i.e., without wealth or children. The reference is to al-Waleed bin al-Mugheerah, who after inclining toward the Qur’ān, denied it publicly in order to win the approval of the Quraysh.

ayahs.translationClear: Leave Me to him whom I created alone.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَجَعَلْتُ لَهُۥ مَالًا مَّمْدُودًا ۝١٢
ayahs.translation: And to whom I granted extensive wealth
ayahs.translationClear: And gave him vast wealth.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَبَنِينَ شُهُودًا ۝١٣
ayahs.translation: And children present [with him]
ayahs.translationClear: And children as witnesses.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمَهَّدتُّ لَهُۥ تَمْهِيدًا ۝١٤
ayahs.translation: And spread [everything] before him, easing [his life].
ayahs.translationClear: And smoothed things for him.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ثُمَّ يَطْمَعُ أَنْ أَزِيدَ ۝١٥
ayahs.translation: Then he desires that I should add more.
ayahs.translationClear: Then he wants Me to add yet more!

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: كَلَّآ‌ۖ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ لِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا عَنِيدًا ۝١٦
ayahs.translation: No! Indeed, he has been toward Our verses obstinate.
ayahs.translationClear: By no means! He was stubborn towards Our revelations.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: سَأُرْهِقُهُۥ صَعُودًا ۝١٧
ayahs.translation: I will cover him with arduous torment.
ayahs.translationClear: I will exhaust him increasingly.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّهُۥ فَكَّرَ وَقَدَّرَ ۝١٨
ayahs.translation: Indeed, he thought and deliberated.[1792]

footnotes.1792: About what he would say concerning the Qur’ān and how he might discredit the Prophet (ﷺ).

ayahs.translationClear: He thought and analyzed.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَقُتِلَ كَيْفَ قَدَّرَ ۝١٩
ayahs.translation: So may he be destroyed [for] how he deliberated.
ayahs.translationClear: May he perish, how he analyzed.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ثُمَّ قُتِلَ كَيْفَ قَدَّرَ ۝٢٠
ayahs.translation: Then may he be destroyed [for] how he deliberated.
ayahs.translationClear: Again: may he perish, how he analyzed.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ثُمَّ نَظَرَ ۝٢١
ayahs.translation: Then he considered [again];
ayahs.translationClear: Then he looked.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ثُمَّ عَبَسَ وَبَسَرَ ۝٢٢
ayahs.translation: Then he frowned and scowled;
ayahs.translationClear: Then he frowned and whined.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ثُمَّ أَدْبَرَ وَٱسْتَكْبَرَ ۝٢٣
ayahs.translation: Then he turned back and was arrogant
ayahs.translationClear: Then he turned back and was proud.

ayahs.textUthmani: فَقَالَ إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌ يُؤْثَرُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَقَالَ إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌ يُؤْثَرُ ۝٢٤
ayahs.textIndopak: فَقَالَ اِنْ هٰذَا͏ٓ اِلَّا سِحْرٌ يُّو͏ٔ͏ْثَرُ ۙ
ayahs.translation: And said, "This is not but magic imitated [from others].
ayahs.transliteration: Faqaala in haathaaa illaa sihruny yu'sar
ayahs.translationClear: And said, “This is nothing but magic from the past.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا قَوْلُ ٱلْبَشَرِ ۝٢٥
ayahs.translation: This is not but the word of a human being."
ayahs.translationClear: This is nothing but the word of a mortal.”

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: سَأُصْلِيهِ سَقَرَ ۝٢٦
ayahs.translation: I will drive him into Saqar.[1793]

footnotes.1793: One of the proper names of Hell.

ayahs.translationClear: I will roast him in Saqar.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا سَقَرُ ۝٢٧
ayahs.translation: And what can make you know what is Saqar?
ayahs.translationClear: But what will explain to you what Saqar is?

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: لَا تُبْقِى وَلَا تَذَرُ ۝٢٨
ayahs.translation: It lets nothing remain and leaves nothing [unburned],
ayahs.translationClear: It neither leaves, nor spares.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: لَوَّاحَةٌ لِّلْبَشَرِ ۝٢٩
ayahs.translation: Altering [i.e., blackening] the skins.
ayahs.translationClear: It scorches the flesh.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: عَلَيْهَا تِسْعَةَ عَشَرَ ۝٣٠
ayahs.translation: Over it are nineteen [angels].
ayahs.translationClear: Over it are nineteen.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَمَا جَعَلْنَآ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلنَّارِ إِلَّا مَلَـٰٓئِكَةً ۙ وَمَا جَعَلْنَا عِدَّتَهُمْ إِلَّا فِتْنَةً لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِيَسْتَيْقِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَيَزْدَادَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِيمَـٰنًا ۙ وَلَا يَرْتَابَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ ۙ وَلِيَقُولَ ٱلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ وَٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ مَاذَآ أَرَادَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَـٰذَا مَثَلًا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهْدِى مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَمَا يَعْلَمُ جُنُودَ رَبِّكَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۚ وَمَا هِىَ إِلَّا ذِكْرَىٰ لِلْبَشَرِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمَا جَعَلْنَآ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلنَّارِ إِلَّا مَلَـٰٓئِكَةً‌ۙ وَمَا جَعَلْنَا عِدَّتَهُمْ إِلَّا فِتْنَةً لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِيَسْتَيْقِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَيَزْدَادَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِيمَـٰنًا‌ۙ وَلَا يَرْتَابَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ‌ۙ وَلِيَقُولَ ٱلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ وَٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ مَاذَآ أَرَادَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَـٰذَا مَثَلًا‌ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهْدِى مَن يَشَآءُ‌ۚ وَمَا يَعْلَمُ جُنُودَ رَبِّكَ إِلَّا هُوَ‌ۚ وَمَا هِىَ إِلَّا ذِكْرَىٰ لِلْبَشَرِ ۝٣١
ayahs.textIndopak: وَمَا جَعَلْنَا͏ٓ اَصْحٰبَ النَّارِ اِلَّا مَلٰ࢜ىِٕكَةًࣕ وَّمَا جَعَلْنَا عِدَّتَهُمْ اِلَّا فِتْنَةً لِّلَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْاۙ لِيَسْتَيْقِنَ الَّذِيْنَ اُوْتُوا الْكِتٰبَ وَيَزْدَادَ الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْٓا اِيْمَانًا وَّلَا يَرْتَابَ الَّذِيْنَ اُوْتُوا الْكِتٰبَ وَالْمُو͏ٔ͏ْمِنُوْنَۙ وَلِيَقُوْلَ الَّذِيْنَ فِيْ قُلُوْبِهِمْ مَّرَضٌ وَّالْكٰفِرُوْنَ مَاذَا͏ٓ اَرَادَ اللّٰهُ بِهٰذَا مَثَلًاؕ كَذٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ اللّٰهُ مَنْ يَّشَا࢜ءُ وَيَهْدِيْ مَنْ يَّشَا࢜ءُؕ وَمَا يَعْلَمُ جُنُوْدَ رَبِّكَ اِلَّا هُوَؕ وَمَا هِيَ اِلَّا ذِكْرٰي لِلْبَشَرِ ࣖ
ayahs.translation: And We have not made the keepers of the Fire except angels. And We have not made their number except as a trial for those who disbelieve - that those who were given the Scripture will be convinced and those who have believed will increase in faith and those who were given the Scripture and the believers will not doubt and that those in whose hearts is disease [i.e., hypocrisy] and the disbelievers will say, "What does Allāh intend by this as an example?" Thus does Allāh send astray whom He wills and guide whom He wills. And none knows the soldiers of your Lord except Him. And it [i.e., mention of the Fire] is not but a reminder to humanity.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-maa ja'alnaaa As-haaban naari illaa malaaa-'ikatanw Wa-maa ja'alnaa 'iddatahum illaa fitnatal lillatheena kafaroo liyastaiqinal latheena ootul kitaaba Wa-yazdaadal latheena aamanooo eemaananw Wa-laa yartaabal latheena ootul kitaaba walmu'minoona Wa-liyaqoolal latheena fee quloo-bihim maradunw walkaafiroona maathaaa araadal laahu bihaathaa masalaa; kathaalika yudillul laahu mai yashaaa'u Wa-yahdee mai yashaaa'; Wa-maa ya'lamu junooda rabbika illaa hoo; Wa-maa hiya illaa thikraa lil-bashar
ayahs.translationClear: We have appointed only angels to be wardens of the Fire, and caused their number to be a stumbling block for those who disbelieve; so that those given the Scripture may attain certainty; and those who believe may increase in faith; and those given the Scripture and the believers may not doubt; and those in whose hearts is sickness and the unbelievers may say, “What did Allah intend by this parable?” Thus Allah leads astray whom He wills, and guides whom He wills. None knows the soldiers of your Lord except He. This is nothing but a reminder for the mortals.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: كَلَّا وَٱلْقَمَرِ ۝٣٢
ayahs.translation: No! By the moon
ayahs.translationClear: Nay! By the moon.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذْ أَدْبَرَ ۝٣٣
ayahs.translation: And [by] the night when it departs
ayahs.translationClear: And the night as it retreats.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱلصُّبْحِ إِذَآ أَسْفَرَ ۝٣٤
ayahs.translation: And [by] the morning when it brightens,
ayahs.translationClear: And the morning as it lights up.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّهَا لَإِحْدَى ٱلْكُبَرِ ۝٣٥
ayahs.translation: Indeed, it [i.e., the Fire] is of the greatest [afflictions]
ayahs.translationClear: It is one of the greatest.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: نَذِيرًا لِّلْبَشَرِ ۝٣٦
ayahs.translation: As a warning to humanity -
ayahs.translationClear: A warning to the mortals.

ayahs.textUthmani: لِمَن شَآءَ مِنكُمْ أَن يَتَقَدَّمَ أَوْ يَتَأَخَّرَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: لِمَن شَآءَ مِنكُمْ أَن يَتَقَدَّمَ أَوْ يَتَأَخَّرَ ۝٣٧
ayahs.textIndopak: لِمَنْ شَا࢜ءَ مِنْكُمْ اَنْ يَّتَقَدَّمَ اَوْ يَتَاَخَّرَ ؕ
ayahs.translation: To whoever wills among you to proceed[1794] or stay behind.
ayahs.transliteration: Liman shaaa'a minkum any yataqaddama aw yata-akhkhar

footnotes.1794: To righteousness by acceptance of the warning.

ayahs.translationClear: To whomever among you wishes to advance, or regress.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: كُلُّ نَفْسٍۭ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ رَهِينَةٌ ۝٣٨
ayahs.translation: Every soul, for what it has earned, will be retained[1795]
ayahs.translationClear: Every soul is hostage to what it has earned.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِلَّآ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْيَمِينِ ۝٣٩
ayahs.translation: Except the companions of the right,[1796].

footnotes.1796: i.e., the righteous who receive their records in their right hands.

ayahs.translationClear: Except for those on the Right.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ ۝٤٠
ayahs.translation: [Who will be] in gardens, questioning each other
ayahs.translationClear: In Gardens, inquiring.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: عَنِ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ ۝٤١
ayahs.translation: About the criminals,
ayahs.translationClear: About the guilty.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: مَا سَلَكَكُمْ فِى سَقَرَ ۝٤٢
ayahs.translation: [And asking them], "What put you into Saqar?"
ayahs.translationClear: “What drove you into Saqar?”

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالُوا۟ لَمْ نَكُ مِنَ ٱلْمُصَلِّينَ ۝٤٣
ayahs.translation: They will say, "We were not of those who prayed,
ayahs.translationClear: They will say, “We were not of those who prayed.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَمْ نَكُ نُطْعِمُ ٱلْمِسْكِينَ ۝٤٤
ayahs.translation: Nor did we used to feed the poor.
ayahs.translationClear: Nor did we feed the destitute.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَكُنَّا نَخُوضُ مَعَ ٱلْخَآئِضِينَ ۝٤٥
ayahs.translation: And we used to enter into vain discourse with those who engaged [in it],
ayahs.translationClear: And we used to indulge with those who indulge.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَكُنَّا نُكَذِّبُ بِيَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ ۝٤٦
ayahs.translation: And we used to deny the Day of Recompense
ayahs.translationClear: And we used to deny the Day of Judgment.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: حَتَّىٰٓ أَتَىٰنَا ٱلْيَقِينُ ۝٤٧
ayahs.translation: Until there came to us the certainty [i.e., death]."
ayahs.translationClear: Until the Inevitable came upon us.”

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَمَا تَنفَعُهُمْ شَفَـٰعَةُ ٱلشَّـٰفِعِينَ ۝٤٨
ayahs.translation: So there will not benefit them the intercession of [any] intercessors.
ayahs.translationClear: But the intercession of intercessors will not help them.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَمَا لَهُمْ عَنِ ٱلتَّذْكِرَةِ مُعْرِضِينَ ۝٤٩
ayahs.translation: Then what is [the matter] with them that they are, from the reminder, turning away
ayahs.translationClear: Why are they turning away from the Reminder?

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: كَأَنَّهُمْ حُمُرٌ مُّسْتَنفِرَةٌ ۝٥٠
ayahs.translation: As if they were alarmed donkeys
ayahs.translationClear: As though they were panicked donkeys.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَرَّتْ مِن قَسْوَرَةٍۭ ۝٥١
ayahs.translation: Fleeing from a lion?
ayahs.translationClear: Fleeing from a lion?

ayahs.textUthmani: بَلْ يُرِيدُ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍ مِّنْهُمْ أَن يُؤْتَىٰ صُحُفًا مُّنَشَّرَةً
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: بَلْ يُرِيدُ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍ مِّنْهُمْ أَن يُؤْتَىٰ صُحُفًا مُّنَشَّرَةً ۝٥٢
ayahs.textIndopak: بَلْ يُرِيْدُ كُلُّ امْرِي͏ٔ͏ٍ مِّنْهُمْ اَنْ يُّو͏ٔ͏ْتٰي صُحُفًا مُّنَشَّرَةً ۙ
ayahs.translation: Rather, every person among them desires that he[1797] would be given scriptures spread about.[1798]
ayahs.transliteration: Bal yureedu kullum ri'im minhum any yu'taa suhufam munashsharah

footnotes.1798: i.e., made public. Much of their refusal of his message was due to envy and jealousy of the Prophet (ﷺ).

ayahs.translationClear: Yet every one of them desires to be given scrolls unrolled.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: كَلَّا‌ۖ بَل لَّا يَخَافُونَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةَ ۝٥٣
ayahs.translation: No! But they do not fear the Hereafter.
ayahs.translationClear: No indeed! But they do not fear the Hereafter.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: كَلَّآ إِنَّهُۥ تَذْكِرَةٌ ۝٥٤
ayahs.translation: No! Indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is a reminder
ayahs.translationClear: Nevertheless, it is a reminder.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَمَن شَآءَ ذَكَرَهُۥ ۝٥٥
ayahs.translation: Then whoever wills will remember it.
ayahs.translationClear: So whoever wills, shall remember it.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَمَا يَذْكُرُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ هُوَ أَهْلُ ٱلتَّقْوَىٰ وَأَهْلُ ٱلْمَغْفِرَةِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمَا يَذْكُرُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ‌ۚ هُوَ أَهْلُ ٱلتَّقْوَىٰ وَأَهْلُ ٱلْمَغْفِرَةِ ۝٥٦
ayahs.textIndopak: وَمَا يَذْكُرُوْنَ اِلَّا͏ٓ اَنْ يَّشَا࢜ءَ اللّٰهُؕ هُوَ اَهْلُ التَّقْوٰي وَاَهْلُ الْمَغْفِرَةِ ࣖ
ayahs.translation: And they will not remember except that Allāh wills. He is worthy of fear and adequate for [granting] forgiveness.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-maa yathkuroona illaaa any yashaaa'al laah; Huwa ahlut taqwaa Wa-ahlul maghfirah
ayahs.translationClear: But they will not remember, unless Allah wills. He is the Source of Righteousness, and the Source of Forgiveness.
